nodes.name: MoS4 intercalation into MgAl LDH
nodes.procedure: MgAl-NO3-LDH and (NH4)2MoS4 were mixed in 1:1 ratio. The aqueous solution containing the materials was degassed, and the resulting suspension was stirred at room temperature for 48 hours. The brown solids were filtered, washed with deionized water and acetone to obtain MoS4-LDH.

nodes.source_text: Ma et al. [109]... To intercalate MoS₄²⁻, they used MgAl-NO₃-LDH and (NH₄)₂MoS₄ with a ratio of 1:1. First, the aqueous solution containing the materials was degassed, and the resulting suspension was stirred at room temperature for 48 hours, and then the brown solids were filtered. After washing with deionized water and acetone, MoS₄-LDH was obtained.

nodes.name: Direct synthesis of ZnAl-CTA-LDH
nodes.procedure: ZnAl-CTA-LDH structure was directly synthesized by direct aging and nucleation process. In this approach, a deionized water solution without CO2 containing Zn(NO3)2·6H2O and CTA was prepared. On the other hand, a solution containing Al(NO3)3·9H2O and CTA was prepared, and an LDH structure was formed by adding these two solutions.
nodes.source_text: In another study, the ZnAl LDH complex was intercalated with chromotropic acid (CTA) for CrVI adsorption. ZnAl-CTA-LDH structure was directly synthesized by direct aging and nucleation process.

nodes.name: General LDH co-precipitation
nodes.procedure: Co-precipitation methods generally include co-precipitation of metal cations in solution, in which a base, such as NaOH, is used to adjust the desired pH for forming LDHs. This method prepares LDHs with high-purity crystals and well-defined morphology.
nodes.source_text: The synthesis techniques of LDHs have been discussed in the literature [58]. Co-precipitation methods generally include co-precipitation of metal cations in solution, in which a base, such as NaOH, is used to adjust the desired pH for forming LDHs.
